name: devpost-mcp
description: Devpost (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Undocumented public JSON used by devpost.com/hackathons: `?page=N&status[]=open` (open hackathons only, fixed); the page size is the site's fixed 9 (`meta.per_page`), so `limit` is not sent and `total` is meta.total_count. No keyword parameter: `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. `deadline` is the display string submission_period_dates (e.g. 'Jul 31 - Oct 01, 2026'), not ISO-8601; prize_amount (HTML), themes[], registrations_count, start_a_submission_url and invite_only stay in `raw`.
